name: LiPo charger + 5 V boost module (IP5306, USB-C)
description: One small board instead of a TP4056 charger plus an MT3608 boost: charges a 1S LiPo from its own USB-C socket and gives a steady 5 V from the cell on OUT, with a low-battery cut-off. BAT / GND.2 to the cell, OUT / GND.3 to a 5 V board (Uno / Nano 5V, a XIAO's 5V through a Schottky diode) or 5 V loads. IN+ / IN− are the USB input: leave them unconnected. Two catches of the IP5306 as sold: it charges at about 2 A (too hard for a cell under 2000 mAh), and it switches OUT off when the load stays under about 45 mA for 32 s (press its KEY, or plug USB, to wake it).

pins.label: IN+
pins.description: USB 5 V input, the same node as the module's USB-C socket (4.5 to 5.5 V). Usually left unconnected: the person plugs a USB charger into the socket. Never wire it to the board's 5V / VBUS.

pins.label: IN−
pins.description: USB input ground (same as the socket's ground). Usually left unconnected.

pins.label: B+
pins.description: To the LiPo cell's + (red). The cell's connection, not a supply output: power the device from OUT.

pins.label: 5V
pins.description: Boosted 5 V output (up to about 2 A) to the device. Off below a 3.0 V cell, and after 32 s under about 45 mA (auto-off) until KEY is pressed or USB is plugged.

props.label: USB cable plugged in
props.description: A USB charger gives the module 5 V: it charges the cell and wakes the output.

props.label: Charge current into the cell
props.description: Set by the chip, not a resistor: the IP5306 as sold charges at about 2 A into the cell (2.1 A from USB). Only the I2C version lowers it. Keep the cell at 2000 mAh or more (1C).

props.label: Light-load auto-off
props.description: The IP5306 as sold turns OUT off when the load stays under about 45 mA for 32 s (it thinks the phone is full). The I2C version (or a module that keeps it awake) can switch this off.

footprint: about 25 × 21 mm module, USB-C socket, solder pads IN+ IN− B+ B− 5V OUT−, KEY pad

features.description: KEY pad / button: wakes the 5 V output after an auto-off; expose it (a plunger) when the load is light

mechanical.source: typical module (IP5306 USB-C charge / boost boards measure about 19 x 22 to 25 x 21 mm; check the listing)

sourcing.generic: IP5306 1S LiPo charge + 5 V boost (power bank) module, USB-C, 2.1 A charge, 5 V 2 A out, low-battery cut-off
